card.name: The word pills after a modifier
card.fires_on: The word "pills" (plural) when it follows a qualifier such as "progestin-only", "missing", "these" or "identifying". It is most common in oral contraceptive text.

modes.label: Contraceptive pills
modes.description: "pills" after progestin-only or missing, in birth control instructions and interaction text.
modes.example: the progestin-only<< pills>> had no effect on lamotrigine

modes.label: Pills in general
modes.description: "pills" as the object of a verb or demonstrative in general text.
modes.example: girl, I want you to try these<< pills>>. They'll help you relax. You

card.plain: It marks the word "pills" when a short modifier comes right before it, mostly in birth control text.
